hooks.command: git fetch -q origin master 2>/dev/null; n=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/master 2>/dev/null); if [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then echo "WARNING: this checkout is $n commit(s) behind origin/master. handoff.md and code here may be stale. Branch from origin/master or run: git merge --ff-only origin/master"; fi
